relationships.subject: alpha-lipoic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: SNL mice exhibited heightened pain sensitivity, which was significantly reduced with ALA administration, improving both mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia

key_findings: ALA alleviated SNL-induced hyperalgesia, reduced oxidative stress, apoptosis and glial/cytokine inflammation, and improved mitochondrial integrity, accompanied by increased PPAR-gamma, Nrf2 nuclear translocation and NF-κB inhibition.
